cases.first_sql:
WITH cash_items AS (
    SELECT oi."product_id", oi."quantity"
    FROM blinkit_order_items oi
    JOIN blinkit_orders o ON o."order_id" = oi."order_id"
    WHERE o."payment_method" = 'Cash'
),
product_brand AS (
    SELECT p."product_id", p."brand"
    FROM blinkit_products p
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT ci."product_id", ci."quantity"
    FROM cash_items ci
),
product_contrib AS (
    SELECT
        ps."product_id",
        COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count,
        SUM(ps."quantity") AS quantity_sum
    FROM product_sales ps
    GROUP BY ps."product_id"
),
brand_contrib AS (
    SELECT
        pb."brand",
        SUM(pc.occurrence_count * pc.quantity_sum) AS brand_total
    FROM product_contrib pc
    JOIN product_brand pb ON pc."product_id" = pb."product_id"
    GROUP BY pb."brand"
),
total_contrib AS (
    SELECT SUM(brand_total) AS total
    FROM brand_contrib
)
SELECT
    bc."brand",
    (bc.brand_total::numeric / NULLIF(tc.total::numeric, 0)) AS sales_ratio
FROM brand_contrib bc
CROSS JOIN total_contrib tc
ORDER BY bc."brand";

  FROM blinkit_delivery_performance dp
  GROUP BY dp."delivery_partner_id"
) dp
WHERE (dp.on_time_orders::numeric / NULLIF(dp."total_orders"::numeric, 0)) < 0.95
ORDER BY dp."delivery_partner_id" ASC
